title: Link embeds keep playing
steps: Open Link embeds tour and start the video. Move the mouse over it, and the cursor onto its link's line (/youtube then Enter in Vim, or click just left of the link): the raw link shows above the video, and the video keeps playing under it. Move off the line: it plays on, in the same frame.
Type while it plays: on the blank line right above the link, and elsewhere in the note. It doesn't stop or reload.
⌘-click another note in the sidebar to open it in a new tab, then click back to the tour's tab: the video is still playing.
Split right (command bar): the video keeps playing, and the new window has its own copy.
Scroll the video out of view and back, and scroll with the mouse wheel over the video: the note scrolls, and the video is where it was.
Change the link itself to another video: that one loads in its place, as it should.
